end.name_zh: 聚源镇储气调峰站／聚源镇
end.name_en: Juyuan Town gas storage and peak-shaving station, Juyuan Town, Dujiangyan
end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '聚源镇,都江堰市' (Juyuan Town boundary centroid, Dujiangyan) -- matches GEM's own EndLocation field 'Juyuan Town'

corridor_notes: Per a China Industrial Economy Information Network article (cinic.org.cn), this is Dujiangyan's 'second natural gas transmission pipeline' (second relative to the D219/Shengping-Puyang line covered under P7685, consistent with GEM's zh_alt '彭州-都江堰D219第二输气管线'), built by Dujiangyan Jinen Gas Co. (investment 85 million yuan) from 彭州石化基地配气站 (Pengzhou Petrochemical Base Gas Distribution Station) to 都江堰市聚源镇储气调峰站 (Juyuan Town gas storage/peak-shaving station, Dujiangyan) -- 34km, DN300, 4MPa design pressure, 600,000 m3/day max capacity, sourced from CNPC Southwest Oil & Gas Field. Construction began March 2012, completed 2012-12-20, built specifically to relieve a post-Wenchuan-earthquake gas shortage affecting 170,000+ households in Dujiangyan. Length (34km) matches GEM's LengthMergedKm exactly.
researcher_notes: Strong corroboration: exact 34km length match plus explicit station-to-station naming from an independent industry-news source. GEM's StartLocation 'Pengzhou' and EndLocation 'Juyuan Town' both confirmed.
blockers: Neither endpoint resolved to a street-level address in Nominatim -- both are city/town-level centroids. A related search surfaced '隆丰街道彭州输气站' (Longfeng Subdistrict Pengzhou Gas Transmission Station) as likely the same or an adjacent facility within the Pengzhou Petrochemical Base, but this could not be independently confirmed as identical to the cinic.org.cn source's named starting station, so it was not used to refine the start coordinate.
